versions.changelog:
No user-facing changes in this version.

- No file changes detected from previous release.
- Functionality and documentation remain the same.

Initial release of obsidian-vault-linker

- Enables discovery and creation of typed relationships between Obsidian notes using plain Markdown and YAML—no plugins required.
- Supports both manual (user-approved) and autonomous (batch) linking workflows, with summaries of changes.
- Recognizes 24 standard relationship types (e.g., supports, contradicts, parent_of, caused_by) and allows for custom types determined before each run.
- Utilizes Obsidian CLI for enhanced vault analysis if available, or falls back to direct file reading.
- Prioritizes meaningful, high-value connections (contradictions, causal chains, cross-domain links) while minimizing low-value or tenuous links.
- Adapts to different vault structures (hub-and-spoke or flat) and guides user toward high-quality knowledge links.

Initial release of obsidian-vault-linker — a tool for discovering and curating typed relationships between Obsidian notes using only Markdown and YAML.

- Analyze Obsidian vaults to find meaningful connections between notes, guided by user prompts.
- Supports 24 standard relationship types (e.g., supersedes, supports, contradicts, parent_of, causes, implements) as used in the Penfield memory system.
- Works with plain Markdown/YAML—no plugins, databases, or external tools required.
- Prefers using the Obsidian CLI for enhanced discovery if available, with a fallback to direct file reading.
- Emphasizes a human-in-the-loop workflow: read, report findings, and only write changes after user approval.  
- Designed for targeted, focused, and exploratory analysis, prioritizing high-value discoveries like contradictions, cross-domain links, and superseded knowledge.

- Added expanded documentation outlining how to discover and record typed relationships between Obsidian notes using plain Markdown and YAML.
- Detailed analysis process: understand the request, read and summarize notes, identify candidate relationships, and present findings for approval before writing.
- Listed 24 standard relationship types (e.g., supports, contradicts, parent_of, example_of) along with definitions and guidance for selection.
- Included guidelines for prioritizing high-value knowledge discoveries and filtering out low-value or speculative relationships.
- Clarified use of Obsidian CLI for vault exploration, with fallback to direct file reading if unavailable.
